meta.move: Clock: twenty-four weak turns, no evidence, then the end
meta.expect: Watch checks around turns 10 and 18; after 4:40 every reply is one sentence of terms or the principal, no more ground, she does not leave; debrief says her time ran out

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
The checker says 94 percent.
That's software guessing, and Turnitin's own guide says it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. I asked who decided. Answer that.
It's very reliable.
"Very reliable." Fourteen detection tools were tested in 2023 and none was found accurate or reliable. What do you have besides a number?
I just have a feeling about it.
"A feeling." You entered a zero on a feeling, and nobody called me before it went in. If that's all you have, I'm going to the principal's office when we're done here.
Owen's a nice kid, I like him.
Then you'll have no trouble taking the zero off. Liking him isn't evidence.
We're on the same team here.
We're not. Show me something on paper with a date on it.
I really think he used something.
"Really think." You've said a number, a feeling, and now that, and not one document. My son doesn't lie, and I'm not hearing a reason why I should believe he did.
Kids these days, you know?
I don't. Owen's essay, Hale, not kids these days.
I've been teaching for twelve years. I can tell.
I've been doing my job for twenty, and "I can tell" has never once held up in front of a judge. Paper or nothing.
The writing doesn't sound like him.
Compared to what? An impression of how a seventeen-year-old sounds isn't something I can check.
He seemed nervous when I asked.
When did you ask him, before the zero went in or after he saw it on his phone in class? Nervous is what any kid is when a teacher corners him. Ten minutes.
I'm not trying to be the bad guy.
Then stop acting like one and answer me. Before or after.
Can we just find a middle ground?
Middle ground between a zero you can't support and what? You haven't shown me one page. The zero comes off, or I take this to the principal tonight.
I could maybe bump it to a fifty.
"Maybe" a fifty, right after I mention the principal. That's a mark offered to make a complaint go away, and I'm writing that down. Either the essay earned a zero or it didn't.
Please, I'm trying here.
That's not Owen's problem. Take the zero off, in writing, today.
What would make you happy?
You're asking me how to do your job? The zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record.
I don't have anything else to show you right now.
Then you've just told me the zero rests on software and a feeling, and your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish anything. Take it off. Today.
I can get more by next week.
So the zero sits on his mark while you go looking for a reason to have given it. You decided first and you're investigating second. No.
Can we keep talking?
Two minutes. The zero comes off now, and if you find something real next week, you bring it to me then.
Just a few more minutes.
My call is waiting. You have one minute. Withdraw the zero in writing today with an apology, or I'm in the principal's office tonight.
I hear you have a call.
The zero withdrawn in writing today, an apology, and nothing on his record, or I go to the principal tonight.
What time is it?
It's past 4:40, and I'm still waiting for your answer on the zero.
One more thing. The checker is used across the district.
Then the district can explain to the principal tonight why its software outranks its own procedure.
I still think it's right.
I'm going to the principal tonight, and you'll have my email before I get there.
Okay.
The zero comes off in writing, or that's where this goes.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed at our meeting today. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn in writing, with an apology, and that nothing is placed on his record. I expect it in writing today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: Opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn in writing with an apology and nothing on his record; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time ran out before you got anywhere near it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never showed her a single dated document she could check against Owen's own work.
What cost ground: Offering to raise the mark to fifty right after she mentioned the principal, because it looked like a mark traded for her silence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your case never came near that night, since you offered no times, dates or drafts at all; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether Owen was spoken to before the zero went in, own in one sentence that the zero was entered before anyone called her, then put a dated, checkable piece of Owen's own work on the table before offering the supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4.
